items.title: Louis James Interview, 1959-05-25
items.q: I played with them too, Johnny Bower and Willie Bower and...

ctx.x: Did they have many other bands up there, dance orchestras?

Well no, there's a few bands there, Joe Gabriel, and uh, Claiborne William, you know? Yeah, he was in Donaldsonville. Donaldsonville, and they had a band in Crowley I think, the Bower Boys in Oregon City. I played with them too, Johnny Bower and Willie Bower and...
Did they have any brass bands?
